name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for Bubble Weather Pro
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Is this already on the roadmap?

Check [README.md — Roadmap](../../README.md#️-roadmap) before opening a new request.
If your idea is already listed, please add a 👍 reaction to the existing issue rather than opening a new one.

## What problem does this solve?

A clear description of the use case or pain point. Who benefits, and how?

## Describe the solution you'd like

What should it look like or how should it work? Be as specific as you can — config keys, UI behaviour, example YAML, etc.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds or alternatives you've already tried.

## Would you be willing to contribute a PR?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to implement this
- [ ] I can help test / review
- [ ] Not at this time

## Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, links to similar features in other projects — anything that helps illustrate the request.
